title: Replay Contract Registry + Mode-Aware Rand Dispatch (Rand pilot)

spike_decisions.dispatch_mechanism: (a) context-threading via EffContext — doc-recommended (b) lowering is INFEASIBLE: _rand_int is referenced only inside os-mode std/rand wrappers, so the outer seeded/crypto mode never reaches the builtin reference site; lowering would require per-caller-mode inlining of std/rand. Thread mode onto EffContext at moded-lambda entry (DeclaredLambdaEffectRow -> EffectModeFor), read it in builtins/rand.go. Retires the iface/cache-leak risk.
spike_decisions.registry_duplication: No duplication. effectSchema (internal/types/effects.go) = validation (which (effect,mode) are legal, closed set). internal/replay/contracts.go = taxonomy ((effect,mode)->{deterministic,re-sampleable,opaque}). Distinct concerns. Guard: add TestReplayContractsAreLegalModes asserting every replay key is legal per effectSchema — effectSchema stays the single source of legal modes.

premise_corrections: rand.go line refs: randSource=:19 (not :28), cryptoSeed=:41, SetRandSeed=:51.
modal_rand.ail: deterministic_roll export=:42, offending rand_seed(42)=:44 (doc said :43). Substance correct: genuine seeded-mode-via-rand_seed bug to fix.

effect_budgets_multi.ail:62 rand_seed(42) is inside main() ! {IO,Rand,Clock} = BARE/os mode. NO mode=seeded anywhere in file. NOT a bug; must NOT be migrated (would violate bare-Rand golden gate). Repurpose as the bare-Rand+rand_seed golden fixture instead. Only modal_rand was ever a real seeded-mode-via-rand_seed caller.

features.notes: EffContext threads Rand mode (randModeState pointer: shared across WithBudget, reset in Clone). FunctionValue.EffectRandMode extracted via types.EffectModeFor; evaluator pushes non-os mode at both CallFunction sites (defer-popped). builtins/rand.go dispatches os/seeded/crypto. seeded from AILANG_SEED/SetSeededModeSeed; no seed -> typed *SeededModeError; crypto entropy panics. Unit-proven: stack discipline, seeded determinism+isolation, no-seed error, crypto range, Clone reset, os byte-identical. LIMITATION: seeded/crypto .ail functions can't call os-mode std/rand wrappers (invariant subsumption) -> runtime works but not reachable from .ail; needs a subsumption decision (surfaced to controller).
